name: One hour of the College (CMO) geomagnetic observatory
source: USGS Geomagnetism Program web service, geomag.usgs.gov/ws
attribution: College (CMO) magnetic observatory, United States Geological Survey (USGS), via the USGS Geomagnetism Program web service. A work of the US Government, public domain.
why_this_hour: An hour with strong long-period (Pc5) pulsations, picked for a demonstration. Nothing drawn from it is a finding.
reduction: reduce.py: summed-axis spectrogram (512 s Hann, 64 s step, to 0.1 Hz) and a 1.67–6.67 mHz zero-phase band-pass of X, Y, Z sampled every 5 s; mean field over the hour
